name: ru_sci_bench_bitext_mining_filtered
description: A filtered Russian scientific bitext dataset intended for bitext mining and parallel-corpus construction in the scientific domain; used to derive high-quality sentence pairs for downstream machine translation and alignment tasks. It measures how well mining/filtering methods can find accurate parallel sentences in Russian↔other-language scientific text.
evaluation_method: precision/recall/F1 for bitext mining quality; BLEU (or other MT metrics) when used for downstream translation evaluation
reputation: A useful, domain-specific resource for Russian scientific parallel data and bitext-mining experiments; used by researchers working on Russian MT and alignment but not a broadly known global benchmark.
